rca_of_issue: User reported (Bangla): 'It shows 6 photos but only 1 image actually loads, the others are missing'. Root cause was two-fold: (1) The `photos` array in the hotspots collection contained duplicate entries whose raw URLs differed only in tracking query params (e.g. ...?utm_campaign=api vs ...?utm_campaign=imageinfo) — the dedup step compared raw URL strings, so these duplicates survived and browser image cache treated them as separate requests. (2) Some photos pointed at the less-reliable `thumb.wikimedia.org` mirror instead of the canonical `upload.wikimedia.org` CDN, which intermittently 404s from Cloudflare-fronted RN apps. Fix (server.py:548-569): added `_canon()` that strips query params and rewrites `thumb.wikimedia.org` -> `upload.wikimedia.org`, then dedups the `photos` array by canonical URL. Fix is applied for both new discoveries AND was replayed as a one-time migration over the existing 18 hotspot documents. Verification: (a) Backend API — every photo URL returned across 17 photos in 3 hotspots is on `upload.wikimedia.org`, no query string, zero duplicates. Shah Jalal shrank 6->5 as expected. (b) Frontend gallery — img.naturalWidth > 0 on all 17 photos across the 3 target hotspots. Bug is fully resolved.
